content: Guzzle has no built-in automatic retry but ships Middleware::retry() to compose exponential backoff deciders on the HandlerStack; must set explicit timeout/connect_timeout (no default). Should retry on connect errors, 429, 503, and respect Retry-After header. GuzzleRetryMiddleware (caseyamcl/guzzle_retry_middleware) is a drop-in package implementing this out of the box.
